description:
Apply, pack and add read a profile package through one validated in-memory type; the parallel captured-tree type folds into it.

## Background

`ProfilePackage` and `CapturedPackageTree` (`crates/jit/src/profile/package_capture.rs:133`) are parallel validated-package types. Both are built through `ProfilePackage::validate_content` (`compose_captured_tree`, `package_capture.rs:697`). The captured tree serves pack (`pack_profile_package_inner`, `crates/jit/src/commands/profile.rs:883`) and add (`read_package_archive`, `crates/jit/src/profile/package_archive.rs:391`), while apply reads `ProfilePackage::from_directory`. The captured tree carries the package files that pack and add need, so the merged type keeps them. Test helpers build captured trees (`crates/jit/src/test_utils.rs`). Line numbers are at the investigation baseline.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: One validated in-memory package type serves apply, pack and add, and the captured-tree type is gone.
- [hard] REQ-02: A package read for apply, read for pack, and extracted by add has the same identity hash on each route.
- [hard] REQ-03: Pack and add tests pass over the merged type.
title: Use one validated profile package type
